category_l2: Unbounded recursion: nested START_GROUP wire-type fields hidden in unknown fields recurse through UnknownFieldSchema.mergeFrom / ArrayDecoders.decodeUnknownField with no depth accounting, and the DiscardUnknownFields path recurses through CodedInputStream.skipMessage, so a crafted message overflows the JVM stack and throws StackOverflowError

discrepancies.detail: The CVE record and the OSV CVE record publish a GIT range introduced 0 fixed 9d0ec0f9 (v3.25.5 release commit) and cc8b3483. Inspection of cc8b3483 shows a 14-insertion 'Internal change' that only normalises whitespace, renames the recursion exception message, makes mergeFrom private and adds the RecursiveGroup proto; it adds NO depth check. It is also not an ancestor of v3.25.5, v28.1 or v28.2. The real checks are 4728531c (3.25.5 branch), ac9fb5b4 (28.2 branch) and d6c82fc5 (main).
discrepancies.topic: CVE/OSV GIT fixed commit is not the actual fix

discrepancies.detail: The OSV record for CVE-2024-7254 contains only a GIT range (repo protocolbuffers/protobuf, introduced 0, fixed 9d0ec0f9 and cc8b3483) and stores the Maven-like events under database_specific.unresolved_ranges. Only the GHSA-735f-pc8j-v9w8 record and page publish the affected Maven packages and the precise ECOSYSTEM ranges.
discrepancies.topic: OSV CVE record has GIT ranges but no Maven ECOSYSTEM ranges

discrepancies.detail: NVD's CPE configuration uses versionStartIncluding 4.28.0 versionEndExcluding 4.28.2 for protobuf-java/javalite/kotlin/kotlin-lite, while the GHSA ECOSYSTEM range starts at 4.28.0-RC1. The NVD range therefore omits the 4.28.0-RC1/RC2 pre-releases, and NVD models the product as the CPE name 'protobuf-java' rather than the Maven coordinate com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java.
discrepancies.topic: NVD CPE range vs Maven range: 4.28.0 vs 4.28.0-RC1

discrepancies.detail: The protobuf-kotlin-lite CPE uses versionEndIncluding 4.28.2 while the other four CPE families use versionEndExcluding 4.28.2, so NVD marks the fixed 4.28.2 release vulnerable for that one product.
discrepancies.topic: NVD protobuf-kotlin-lite CPE end is inclusive

discrepancies.detail: The GHSA uses Maven versions beginning 4.28.0-RC1 and 4.28.2; the CNA publishes a repository-stream version lessThan '28.2' (tag numbering, no leading 4) and, separately, Maven ranges lessThan 4.28.2 from version 0, which is coarser and would also include branches that were fixed earlier (4.27.5). Tag v28.1 maps to Maven artifact 4.28.1, confirmed by the 4.28.1 POM.
discrepancies.topic: Version naming: tag 28.x vs Maven 4.28.x vs CNA lessThan 28.2

discrepancies.detail: CNA problemTypes are CWE-400 (uncontrolled resource consumption) and CWE-674 (uncontrolled recursion). The GHSA cwe_ids are CWE-20, CWE-400 and CWE-787. NVD's primary weakness is CWE-787 (out-of-bounds write), which does not describe a StackOverflowError, while NVD's Google secondary entry lists CWE-400/CWE-674.

The CNA and NVD secondary publish CVSS 4.0 8.7 HIGH; NVD's own primary metric and the GHSA publish CVSS 3.1 7.5 HIGH. The GHSA page displays 8.7. OSV's CVE record exports the 4.0 vector without a numeric score, so a consumer reading only OSV severity cannot recover 8.7.
discrepancies.topic: Severity is published on two CVSS versions

discrepancies.detail: 4728531c/850fcce9 are the 25.x-branch fix and precursor (ancestors of v3.25.5); 9a5f5fe7/ac9fb5b4 are their 28.x cherry-picks (ancestors of v28.2); cc8b3483 is the main-branch precursor the CVE names as fixed; d6c82fc5 is the main-branch squash of PR #18388. Only ac9fb5b4 is the v28.2 release fix, and none of the six is an ancestor of v28.1.
discrepancies.topic: Six advisory-listed commits are three duplicated pairs plus a squash

discrepancies.detail: The GHSA page shows 'Sep 18, 2024', OSV gives published 2024-09-19T16:06:03Z for GHSA-735f-pc8j-v9w8, and the CVE record gives 2024-09-19T00:18:45.824Z; these are the same event recorded in different systems and time bases, not separate advisories.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: The Google CNA publishes CVSS 4.0 8.7 HIGH; NVD carries the same 8.7 as a secondary metric and the GitHub advisory page displays 'High CVSS4.0 Score 8.7'. NVD's own primary metric is CVSS 3.1 7.5 HIGH (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H), which the GHSA and OSV also carry. All published metrics are HIGH; the numeric difference is the CVSS version, not a disagreement about impact. OSV's CVE record exports the CVSS 4.0 vector only with no numeric score. The weakness classification does disagree: CNA CWE-400/CWE-674, GHSA CWE-20/CWE-400/CWE-787, and NVD primary CWE-787.
severity.source: Google CNA (CVE record) CVSS 4.0 8.7; NVD secondary CVSS 4.0 8.7; NVD primary CVSS 3.1 7.5; GHSA 3.1 7.5 and displayed 4.0 8.7
